## Annotation

The profile says a “pivotal point” came in 1985 when Lawrence “joined several fellow quadriplegics and moved into semi-independent living at the newly constructed **Creekside** development—an innovative housing cooperative championed by SCI BC’s Doug Mowat.”

That spelling (**Creekside**) disagrees with Haw 1989 and Fayerman 2018 (**Creekview**). This archive records the discrepancy and does not pick a winner. The page also attributes championship of the housing cooperative to Doug Mowat; that is SCI BC’s later wording.

The article does not mention CSIL or ECPM.
